statement: The closed set of reasons a capability may be deferred at vocabulary version V1. Every entry in the deferred capability registry pins the vocabulary version it was written against, so a later version can never retroactively change what a past event meant.

sourceOfTruth.note: V1 is seeded verbatim from the Owner-ratified GATE24 mandate vocabulary. The mandate is not modified, referenced by path only, and remains the semantic authority for the tokens it defines.

reasonRule: Every deferred capability carries at least one reason from the pinned vocabulary version. A reason of "later", an empty reason or a missing reason is forbidden and is a defect.

extensionPolicy.requires: A new vocabulary version document authorized by an explicit Owner decision. Renaming or removing a token would silently rewrite the meaning of already-written events.
extensionPolicy.nonAuthoritativeSpellingsNote: Paraphrases that appeared in working prose. They are NOT vocabulary tokens and are rejected; the ratified spellings below are authoritative.

reasons.meaning: The causal vintage of the inputs is not yet proven.
The capability has no canonical identity yet.
The availableAt policy is not yet complete.
Historical coverage is insufficient to activate.
The classifying role of the capability is not yet proven.
Possible redundancy against active inputs is not yet evaluated.
Predictive value is owned by a later gate, not this one.
The taxonomy for this capability is intentionally deferred.
The capability is not required by the current CORE_V1 scope.
